reviews.resolution: Active reducer remains the only Field state writer; Field System is an architecture domain label only.
Read Model writes projection candidates only and retains no Field mutation authority.
Observation owns evidence collection candidates but not Cognitive Attention, cognition, or Decision.
Task lifecycle ownership remains distinct from Intent, Causal Reasoning, Decision, Runtime dispatch, and Action.
Model capability ownership remains separate from cognitive conclusion and Decision authority.
Cognitive OS is the governance domain; Protocol Manager remains the active module owner.
OCR remains an evidence producer without fact, Memory, Decision, or Action authority.
Vision remains an evidence producer without world-state, Decision, or Action authority.
Memory remains the sole historical persistence and retrieval owner; PCN consumes references only.
PCN owns typed connection, activation, and projection candidates only and cannot own or mutate source objects.
Intent Candidate governance remains distinct from Goal, Task, Decision, and Action ownership.
Causal outputs remain revisable candidates and gain no fact, Decision, or Action authority.
Experience outputs remain candidates and cannot directly write Memory, Schema, or PCN.
B Route remains future-simulation candidate space and cannot override A Route Reality or Decision.
Decision Arbitration selects candidates only and remains separate from Task lifecycle and Action execution.
